audit_port.backends: PostgreSQL real authority (separate committed write/read connections) plus fsync/flock journal versions. Existing in-memory fixtures are reference regression, not evidence of service backend conformance.

audit_port.missing: Explicit CONTROL_PLANE_UNAVAILABLE/AUDIT_UNAVAILABLE on refusal; successful admissions retain existing atomic audit
audit_port.request_metadata: No payload/candidate, raw operation ID, claimed GCS or exception text; trusted binding refs/GCS digest/correlation only. UTF8 surrogatepass operation fingerprint (SHA256); bounded uppercase detail vocabulary, malformed detail ->ADMISSION_REJECTED.

limitations: The port trusts the audit authority acknowledgement. Deployment-specific writer protection is outside this change; no production or conformance claim.

Unexpected ledger failures are exercised before atomic append. Atomicity of the existing MemoryVersionLedger remains its required provider contract; this change does not promise rollback of an acknowledged append.
